C0743.title: Dreame Technology Issues Anti-Fraud Notice: Three Employees Suspected of Criminal Offenses
C0743.summary: Dreame Technology released an internal anti-fraud notice stating that three employees have been transferred to judicial authorities on suspicion of criminal offenses including occupational embezzlement. The company maintains a zero-tolerance stance toward disciplinary and illegal acts.
